title: World Championship Decks 1998: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Our belief shall be the lance that pierces Volrath's heart."
"An angel appeared in the smoldering skies above the fray, her clothes as flames, her armor as fire." —"Hymn of Angelfire"
The swarm seemed unmoved by the artificial slivers' destruction. "They clearly were not the leaders," Hanna cursed. "I guess we'll have to do this the hard way."
"I'm too modest a wizard to reveal the full extent of my abilities." —Ertai, wizard adept
Count carefully the souls and see that none are lost. —Vec teaching
Only a matter as vital as destroying Volrath could bring together the reclusive Kor people.
The *Weatherlight* dragged the *Predator* behind it, the cradle hauling the casket.
"Prayer rarely explains." —Orim, Samite healer
"In Rath," the priest said, "there is even greater need for prayer."
"I regret feeding Kaervek's hunger for power—far better to live with animals innocent of such ambitions." —Jolrael
Out of the blackness and stench of the engulfing swamp emerged a shimmering figure. Only the splattered armor and ichor-stained sword hinted at the unfathomable evil the knight had just laid waste.
The Kor forsake roots for the winding of the path; forsake voices for the silence of the mind; forsake all else for the poverty of isolation.
"Some believe Sandstalkers to be illusions; those with scars know better." —*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*
"Glok loved storms! He'd sit an' watch an' laugh through the whole thing. I miss him." —Squee, goblin cabin hand
"Fetch the pestridder, Paka—we've got dwarves in the rutabagas!" —Jamul, Femeref farmer
Want all, lose all. —Zhalfirin aphorism
The first morning after acquiring her familiar, the wizard awoke with fleabites and mange.
"Never taunt an embermage, 'What are you going to do about it?'" —Akin, seasoned askari
"I got it! I got it! I—"
Generations of genetic weeding have given rise to the deviously cowardly Ironclaw clan.
"I am reminded of the fable of the silver egg. Its owner cracks it open to see what jewels it holds, only to discover a simple yellow yolk." —Karn, silver golem
"The land promises nothing and keeps its promise." —Oracle *en*-Vec
Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.
They'll attack whatever's in front of them—as long as you tell them where that is.
Lightning tethers souls to the world. —Kor saying
They wouldn't know their house from a charred hole in the ground.
"Is it true that the apes wear furs of gold when they marry?" —Rana, Suq'Ata market fool
Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.
"These moonless, foreign skies keep me in thrall. Dark whispers echo in the night, and I cannot resist." —Selenia, dark angel
The seed of a world's evil.
When the eagle catches a cloud, it tears it into strips that fall to earth. —Vec myth of the rains
"The fishers will throw out their nets and draw them back filled with dust." —Oracle *en*-Vec
Jolrael's choice of homes was far better than her choice of allies.
"Just the thing for those pesky water mages." —Jaya Ballard, Task Mage
Sometimes the wise ones wove their magic into living plants; as the plant grew, so grew the magic.
Burl, scurf, and bower Birth fern and flower.
"The reflection of land interests me far more than its reality." —Volrath
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch." —Naimah, Femeref philosopher
"Hold your position! Leave doubt for the dying!" —Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*
"I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say." —Jolrael
"I am confined by sleep and defined by nightmare." —Crovax
"Just take a little off the top."
It is said that the wind will blow the world past if you wait long enough.
"I followed her song only to find it was a dirge." —Crovax
"Memory is a burden that wears at the soul as weather wears at stone." —Crovax
"Um . . . oh . . . what was I saying?" —Reveka, Wizard Savant
"Controlling time ensures you need never look impulsive again." —Teferi
"The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy." —Volrath
"No one can catch what won't be caught." —Kakra, Sea Troll
"A beauty made more so by its fleeting visitations." —Teferi
"It was probably a lousy spell in the first place." —Ertai, wizard adept
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny." —Ertai, wizard adept
"If you weren't born with it, you don't need it." —Grahilah, former trader of Amiqat
"Heed the lessons of our time: the forms of water may move the land itself and hold captive the fires within." —Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage
